# Fixture configuration

Ordinary: Early / **Bold** / \*Literal\*.

```
Code: {name} / {bold} / {raw}.
```

Literal: **bold** / Early / [Site](https://example.org).

Escaped: \\\[subs="none"\] stays text.

Ordinary after assignment: Late / **Bold**.

```
Literal block: {name} / {bold} / \{name}.
```
